verdict.rationale: Project templates are a fair question for a project-planning tool like Linear, but the evidence pack never documents pre-built templates for starting a new project. The project composer (AI-assisted ideation before creating a project) and shared skills (standardizing recurring workflows) are adjacent features, not pre-built project templates, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can jumpstart a new project using pre-built templates
